title: Olist E-Commerce Analytics Platform
problem: What do Olist's sales, customer and delivery data show about how the business is performing?
approach: Loaded and cleaned the Brazilian Olist dataset, analyzed it with SQL in MySQL, and worked with it from Python using SQLAlchemy.
result: An interactive Power BI dashboard with DAX measures covering sales, customers and delivery performance.

title: Amazon Clothing Sales (Power BI)
problem: Where does clothing revenue come from, and how do sales move over time?
approach: Analyzed revenue trends, top categories and sales patterns in Power BI with DAX.

title: Zameen EDA
problem: How do Pakistani property prices vary by city, property type and size?
approach: A Python pipeline standardizing Pakistani price and area formats (Crore, Lakh, Marla, Kanal).
result: Distribution charts, median-price comparisons and a correlation heatmap. This is descriptive analysis, not a price-prediction model.

title: Hospital Management System (SQL)

approach: Designed a relational database for the hospital, then wrote analytical SQL queries on top of it.
